deploy-bot: PROMOTION BLOCKED: preflight check `verify-signature` failed for commit abc1234 (staging -> canary). blocking job: `ci/preflight/verify-signature`

jamie: ugh. what exactly failed? logs?

marie: paste from CI: ```
+ git verify-commit abc1234
error: no public key found for user 'CI Runner <ci@redwood.ai>'
fatal: failed to verify signature
```

sanjay: looks like the commit was signed but CI runner doesn't have the signing key. odd — we expect signed commits only for release branches though. did someone force-push a signed commit to release/1.7?

marie: yep, someone created a small docs fix and signed it locally, then force-pushed. the build artifact and image uploaded fine, but preflight refuses to promote unless signature verifies.

jamie: the release window is T+30m. if we wait for a re-signed commit or re-build, we'll miss the window. options: (1) re-run CI with key (no, we can't add private keys to shared runners), (2) ask dev to unsigned-commit and push, (3) manual pin to last-good image and proceed, (4) force-promote bypassing signature check (dangerous).

oncall-sre: manual pin seems safest. we can promote previous canary that passed full preflight. less blast radius than bypassing checks.

sanjay: agree. tradeoffs: pin keeps release on last-tested binary; but release notes include docs fix — small. we can schedule a targeted hotfix in next patch.

marie: i can open a hotfix branch now and reapply the docs change unsigned, trigger CI, and then promote after canary if we want to keep the change in this window. but that is tight.

jamie: decision? do we want to hold the window for 30-45m for hotfix or pin?

oncall-sre: recommend pin. proceed with promoting image: `gcloud run deploy --image gcr.io/redwood-artifacts/service:2026-03-23-1234` (last-good). mark release notes: "docs fix deferred to 1.7.1". create follow-up ticket for re-signing flow.

sanjay: +1. i'll create the rollback/pin PR and add the deploybot command to manually promote the pinned tag.

marie: creating hotfix branch and CI just in case; won't block promotion.

jamie: OK pinned and promoting now. deploy-bot, please escalate if any other preflight fails. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: manual promotion started by jamie. promotion job id: 98765. will post status.

marie: filing postmortem action items: 1) document policy for signed commits on release branches, 2) update CI to handle signed commits or reject them earlier in PR, 3) add explicit runbook for signature-check blocks.

jamie: thanks all. running release notes update and will ship.

sanjay: tagging @release-managers in the follow-up ticket.
